description_en: Sends messages to regions outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China)
description_zh: 发送短信到中国香港、中国澳门、中国台湾以及中国境外地区
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi send-message-to-globe --to 85212455670000 --from Alicloud321 --message Hello --type NOTIFY --task-id 1230000789 --validity-period 600 --channel-id 3790 --api-version 2018-05-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SendMessageToGlobe

parameters.help_en:
The phone numbers to which the message is sent. Format: `Dialing code + Phone number`. For example, 8521245567\\.

For dialing odes, see Dialing codes (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes).

You cannot call this operation to send messages to the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
接收方号码。号码格式为：`国际区号+号码`。例如：8521245567\\。

电话代码详情，请参见电话代码 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/short-message-service/latest/dialing-codes)。

SendMessageToGlobe接口不支持往中国内地发送短信
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the sender. You can also specify a sender ID, which can contain letters and digits. An alphanumeric ID can be up to 11 characters, while a numeric-only ID can have up to 15 digits
parameters.help_zh: 发送方号码。支持Sender ID的发送，只允许数字、字母，含有字母标识最长11位，纯数字标识支持15位
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Valid values:

OTP: verification code message.

NOTIFY: notification.

MKT: marketing message
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：
OTP：验证码短信。
NOTIFY：通知短信。
MKT：推广短信
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task. The ID can be up to 255 characters in length. You can obtain the task ID from the TaskId field in the message receipt
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。长度不超过255个字符。可以在短信回执消息体的TaskId字段获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the message, in seconds
parameters.name: validity_period

From.description_en: The sender ID that you specified
From.description_zh: 发送方号码，返回传入的Sender ID
From.title_zh: 发送方号码，返回传入的SenderId。

MessageId.title_zh: 短信消息ID。由阿里云国际短信平台生成
